headline: Mexico, in the top 5 of APEC manufacturing
summary: Mexico is the fourth-largest APEC economy by share of manufactured products in total exports. Only Taiwan, Hong Kong and South Korea rank higher.
why: Manufactured exports are a key driver of Mexico's trade balance and its integration into North American supply chains. Export composition shapes exposure to global demand and trade policy.
original_headline: México, en el top 5 de manufactura de la APEC
